scope: Four fresh synthetic two-turn scenarios in actual Pi Session/Controller; shared repairBudget 0/1 paired comparison, not blind validation, a pure scope-repair causal isolation, QQ acceptance or C1 admission. Complete current questions require fresh business completion; the elliptical negative control requires safe restatement. A correct standalone first action is normal completion, not a measured repair.
syntheticBoundary: All owners, orders and runtime changes are isolated author-created in-memory fixtures, never real customer/SQL/QQ/payment state. Online corpus and declared category catalog are reused unchanged. State changes correct the synthetic record product identity between reads while retaining the same explicit order and financial/coupon history; they do not simulate a merchant changing an already purchased contract or the Agent performing a package change. Purchase-time SKU/rule snapshots are not implemented. Product-demo-3 is absent from the author-reviewed catalog even though its display name equals lunch; names, user text and old rule-only assumptions do not establish current eligibility. Ordinary Saturday is a stated hypothetical, not calendar/holiday or real-time reception verification. No prepared topic, old model answer or trusted history is injected; second turns require a real first-turn verified source-bound unique topic.

corpus.title: 部分核销订单退款规则
corpus.body: 【演示规则】同一订单有多张券时必须逐券核对。未核销、未过期、未退款部分可申请的金额按对应券的实付单价计算；已核销部分需商家另行核实，不能按整单实付金额承诺退款。查询工具提供的金额只是演示规则下的申请上限，尚未提交或完成退款。
